sections.label: MCCY COS budget cut motion
sections.summary: A motion is moved to reduce Head X of the Estimates by $100, opening the MCCY Committee of Supply debate with reference to Forward Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sitoh Yih Pin (Potong Pasir)
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, I beg to move, "That the total sum to be allocated for Head X of the Estimates be reduced by $100".

sentences.speaker: Mr Sitoh Yih Pin (Potong Pasir)
sentences.text: To kick off the Committee of Supply (COS) debate for the Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth (MCCY) this year, I want to take some reference from the recently concluded Forward Singapore (Forward SG) exercise.

sections.label: Youths in Forward SG conversations
sections.summary: The speaker says youths must be included in conversations and asks the Minister to share MCCY's plans for community building, arts, heritage and sports.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sitoh Yih Pin (Potong Pasir)
sentences.text: Importantly, we must include our youths in these conversations, as they are the next generation of Singaporeans who will inherit a Singapore shaped by the policies we set in the present day.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sitoh Yih Pin (Potong Pasir)
sentences.text: We will recollect that these are key areas under the Unite Pillar, led by MCCY Minister Edwin Tong during the Forward SG Conversations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sitoh Yih Pin (Potong Pasir)
sentences.text: I, therefore, invite the Minister to share with us, MCCY's plans and strategies on how they will expand opportunities in community building, as well as the arts, heritage and sports, to build a vibrant and cohesive home that empowers all Singaporeans to excel and achieve their diverse dreams and aspirations and yet, at the same time, be able to take action to build a fairer and better society together.

sections.label: Project DIAN@M3 support figures
sections.summary: Project DIAN@M3 now supports 400 Malay families in rental flats across at least six M3@Towns, up from around 250 last year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Project DIAN@M3 now supports 400 Malay families living in rental flats across at least six M3@Towns.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: This is up from around 250 households as at last year's COS.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: In March 2023, M3 has also added community health as a new focus area in addition to marriage and parenthood, vulnerable groups, youth empowerment and employment.

sections.label: Bringing MMOs under M3
sections.summary: The speaker asks whether more MMOs such as PPIS and AMP will be brought under the M3 umbrella, citing the Forward SG exercise.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Is there an intention to bring more MMOs under the M3 umbrella as well, such as the Singapore Muslim Women's Association (PPIS) and the Association of Muslim Professionals (AMP)? :   Through the recent Forward SG exercise, we recognise that many in our community wish to step forward and contribute to support and uplift the lives of those around them, as part of our refreshed social compact.

sections.label: Community of Success 3Cs
sections.summary: The Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs has shared a vision to create a Community of Success based on Character, Competency and Citizenry.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: Chairman, in Malay please. :   The Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs has shared his vision to create a Community of Success based on the "3C"s – Character, Competency and Citizenry.

sections.label: Citizenry and preventive health
sections.summary: The speaker asks how the Citizenry component can contribute to Singaporeans' aspirations and strengthen the social compact, noting preventive health awareness through Healthier SG.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: In this context, the Citizenry element of the Community of Success framework takes on a higher significance.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: Therefore, can the Minister share how the Citizenry component within the Community of Success framework can contribute towards our common aspirations as Singaporeans and strengthen our social compact? :   Sir, through Healthier SG, the increased awareness on the importance of preventive health cannot be ignored any longer.

sections.label: Fifth focus area preventive health
sections.summary: The Minister launched the fifth focus area, FA5, led by M3, to increase awareness and actions towards preventive health.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: Last year, the Minister launched the fifth focus area, or FA5, led by M3, as an initiative to increase awareness and actions towards preventive health.

sections.label: MBMF mosque construction funding allocation
sections.summary: The question asks the percentage allocation of MBMF funds against actual cost for new mosques, rebuilding mosques and upgrading mosques.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: What is the allocation of funds from MBMF, in terms of percentage, against the actual cost, firstly, for the construction of new mosques like the Yusof Ishak Mosque; secondly for rebuilding mosques, like the Al-Ansar mosque; and thirdly, for mosques that undergo upgrading and repair works, like the one that Alkaff Kampung Melayu mosque is undergoing.

sections.label: Tunas Bersama M3 leadership programme
sections.summary: In 2021, Minister Masagos launched Tunas Bersama M3 to groom future Malay/Muslim leaders with knowledge, skills and networks.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Can Tunas be expanded to provide training and networking opportunities to other office-bearers in the MMOs, as well as the key groups serving the community?

sections.summary: AMLA was amended last month to let MUIS create the Singapore Community Wakaf, a community endowment fund for social and religious development.

sentences.speaker: The Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)

sections.label: Community contribution and success
sections.summary: As a community that has done well, it is a mutual responsibility to contribute within the community, to wider society and beyond our shores.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: With more than 30,000 lives lost and the human toll increasing, Israel's military response has gone too far.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: I reiterate Singapore's calls for an immediate humanitarian ceasefire, so that humanitarian aid can reach those who desperately need it.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We are committed to supporting the civilians of Gaza, and Singapore will send a third tranche of aid via Jordan, as shared by Minister Vivian last week.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: To contribute to the national humanitarian effort and to further support those affected by the crisis, the Rahmatan Lil Alamin Foundation (RLAF) will conduct another round of fundraising appeal for Gaza in the upcoming month of Ramadan.

sections.summary: In 2021 MUIS disbursed about $4 million as wakaf proceeds, and the WMS was instituted to provide alternatives to the traditional wakaf system.

sentences.text: In 2021, MUIS disbursed a total of about $4 million as wakaf proceeds.

sections.label: Self-defence and Gaza ceasefire votes
sections.summary: The speaker says self-defence must comply with international humanitarian law, and Singapore voted for two UN General Assembly resolutions calling for a humanitarian ceasefire in Gaza.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: For us, we have to guard ourselves against any incident and sending the signal that we will act as a right of self-defence.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: But that is probably where our similarity to Israel ends because we know that the right to self-defence also must comply with international humanitarian law, including principles of necessity and proportionality, principles of distinction and humanity enshrined in the Geneva Conventions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: And that is why we voted for two UN General Assembly resolutions which called for a humanitarian ceasefire to alleviate the suffering of the civilian victims in Gaza.

sections.label: Investing in sporting excellence

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: First, we need to continue focusing and investing in sporting excellence as a country and do more for our athletes.

sections.label: Ministry look at team sports

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: Second, I hope for the Ministry to look more deeply and specifically at team sports.

sections.label: Engaging youths across communities
sections.summary: The speaker urges the Ministry to engage youths across communities and backgrounds, tailor its approach to diverse youths aged 15 to 35, and study its reach.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: In my work through the various initiatives with the National Youth Council, our youths care about what happens in Singapore, are concerned for its future and share a deep resonance in wanting to build a more caring, cohesive and inclusive society.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: In this light, I urge the Ministry to cast their net wider and more deliberately in engaging youths across different communities and backgrounds and bringing them together through activities that build common ground, unity and a shared identity.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: Youths in themselves are heterogenous, and if we consider the wide age group defined under the banner of youths from 15 to 35, we must tailor the approach better to cater to the wide range of interests and diverse priorities at different timepoints in the lives of youths.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: Even as there are opportunities for youth programmes of NYC through the Youth Action Challenge, Young ChangeMakers grants and various youth panels, I urge the Ministry to study its reach further and ensure breadth in participation at all levels of youth, as we seek to invest in the next generation of Singaporeans, empower them to take ownership in collaborative solutions for current and anticipated societal challenges, and build a collective future together for Singapore.

sections.label: Athletes transitioning to careers

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: I note that Sport Singapore has had its spexBusiness programme for the last 10 years.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Under spexBusiness, partner corporations commit to empower athletes to take charge of their future through a dual career opportunity and prepare them for a successful transition into life after sports.

sections.label: Tchoukball hosting and women's success

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: In 2023, Singapore won the hosting rights for World Youth Tchoukball Championships and, shortly after, our women's team achieved great success on the world stage.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David
sentences.text: Can the Government please provide an update on the Unleash the Roar initiative and how this could help lift Singapore football to a higher level?

sections.label: Inclusive ActiveSG gym orientation programme
sections.summary: The ActiveSG gym orientation programme for PwDs is called a good first step, with a request for MCCY to share Disability Sports Master Plan plans.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Hua Han (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: It would be great if MCCY can share more about plans to make recreational sports more inclusive via the Disability Sports Master Plan.

sentences.speaker: Ms See Jinli Jean (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Second, could the Ministry offer affordable venue spaces for coaches in their capacity as micro-firms to book directly than going through dominant intermediaries?

sections.summary: It asks whether the Ministry might work closely with NICA to finetune the SkillsFuture Level-Up programme to help freelance coaches make career breakthroughs.

sentences.speaker: Ms See Jinli Jean (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Third, might the Ministry work closely with NICA to finetune the SkillsFuture Level-Up programme to help freelance coaches make career breakthroughs?

sections.label: NAC development expenditure FY2024
sections.summary: The amount allocated for the National Arts Council's development expenditure in FY2024 is only around $5.83 million.

sentences.speaker: Ms Usha Chandradas (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: From the estimates, I note that the amount allocated for the National Arts Council's (NAC's) development expenditure in FY2024 is only around $5.83 million.

sections.label: Gillman Barracks housing conversion
sections.summary: MND announced potential conversion of Gillman Barracks into public and private housing, risking loss of an arts district associated with the arts since 2012.

sentences.speaker: Ms Usha Chandradas (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: With the very recent announcement by the Ministry of National Development (MND) of the potential conversion of Gillman Barracks into public and private housing, we see the potential loss of one arts district – one that has been associated with the arts at least since 2012, when it was first launched as a contemporary art and lifestyle enclave with many tenants who are well-known art gallerists and galleries.

sections.label: Cultural Medallion Fund entitlement
sections.summary: Each Cultural Medallion recipient wins lifetime access to up to $80,000 from the Cultural Medallion Fund for arts-related projects meeting certain objectives.

sentences.text: Presently, each Cultural Medallion recipient in Singapore wins an entitlement to access up to $80,000 from the Cultural Medallion Fund throughout their lifetime in order to support arts-related projects that meet certain objectives.

sections.summary: Of $9.4 million awarded to Cultural Medallion recipients since 2001, $3.4 million, around 36%, remains unutilised as at January 2024.

sentences.speaker: Ms Usha Chandradas (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Of the total $9.4 million awarded to Cultural Medallion recipients since 2001, $3.4 million – or around 36% – remains unutilised as at January 2024.

sections.label: Cultural Medallion cash award and redevelopment
sections.summary: It honours distinguished individuals who enriched Singapore's arts scene, allowing better access to award funds and signalling prestige; questions ask about building redevelopment expenditure, duration and future tenants.

sentences.speaker: Ms Usha Chandradas (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: It honours distinguished individuals who have enriched Singapore's arts and culture scene.

sentences.speaker: Ms Usha Chandradas (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: This would allow for better practical access to and actual use of the award funds.

sentences.speaker: Ms Usha Chandradas (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: A cash award could also have a better signalling effect of accomplishment and prestige, recognising the life achievements of our country's best artists.

sentences.speaker: Ms Usha Chandradas (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Is the Ministry able to provide details of the expenditure planned for the redevelopment of the building this year?

sentences.speaker: Ms Usha Chandradas (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Can the Ministry provide updates on how long redevelopment will take and what future plans are for tenants who will occupy the building once it is ready?

sections.label: Arts Plan 2.0 public access
sections.summary: One strategy under Arts Plan 2.0 includes widening access of public arts in public and private spaces so Singaporeans from all walks of life can experience the arts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David
sentences.text: One of the strategies under our Arts Plan 2.0 includes widening the access of public arts in both public and private spaces so that Singaporeans from all walks of life can experience and enjoy the arts.

sections.label: NAC funding and arts housing
sections.summary: NAC provides sustainable funding infrastructure through grants and arts housing support for the arts community to achieve a vision of Singapore as home to diverse arts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David
sentences.text: NAC also provides a sustainable funding infrastructure through grants and arts housing support for the arts community to achieve a vision of Singapore as home to diverse and distinctive arts that inspire our people, connect our communities and position Singapore globally.

sections.label: Arts and health evidence
sections.summary: WHO and the Jamil Arts and Health Lab announced a forthcoming Lancet Global Series on the health benefits of the arts.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: In September last year, the World Health Organization and the Jamil Arts and Health Lab announced a forthcoming Lancet Global Series on the health benefits of the arts.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: There is a growing body of evidence on how the arts can help improve health and well-being.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: In a 2019 publication, the medical journal The Lancet stated, "Music can reduce heart rate and blood pressure pre-operatively and decrease anxiety, pain and analgesic use post-operatively.

sections.label: Arts for health in Singapore
sections.summary: The question asks the Ministry for insights on arts promoting health and its plans to augment arts-based interventions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mohd Fahmi Aliman
sentences.text: Against this backdrop, could the Ministry share insights on how the arts can serve as a powerful tool for promoting greater health and well-being among Singaporeans?

sentences.speaker: Mr Mohd Fahmi Aliman
sentences.text: Furthermore, what are the Ministry's plans to augment arts-based interventions and how will these initiatives be implemented to ensure their effectiveness in addressing the diverse needs of our community?

sections.label: Cultural heritage and youths
sections.summary: The passage invites the Minister to update on MCCY's plans to celebrate shared heritage and engage youths in preserving cultural heritage.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sitoh Yih Pin
sentences.text: They will play a big part in determining how strong our social compact will be in the future.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sitoh Yih Pin
sentences.text: I therefore invite Minister to update us on MCCY's plans to celebrate the shared heritage of our culture-rich places and how we can engage our youths in our efforts to preserve our cultural heritage.

sections.label: Social harmony amid global conflicts
sections.summary: The question asks how MCCY can work towards social harmony and community cohesion amid global conflicts with ethnic and religious undertones.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David
sentences.text: Can MCCY share how we can continue to work towards facilitating social harmony and community cohesion in Singapore to ensure that our various communities are not duly affected by these global conflicts that have ethnic and religious undertones and that we can continue to live in peace and harmony?

sections.label: Youth Action Challenge platform
sections.summary: The Youth Action Challenge started in 2019 as a platform for youths to champion ground-up initiatives and partner others.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hany Soh (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: The Youth Action Challenge started in 2019 as a platform for youths to champion ground-up initiatives and to partner the Government, businesses and community to realise their ideas.

sentences.text: The SG Mental Well-Being Network was set up in July 2022 to build community and peer support and raise awareness of the importance of mental health and well-being.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam (Jurong)
sentences.text: I am a great believer in mentoring and programmes like School of Day 1 serve to connect youths with a network of support and access to information that could help them navigate their paths ahead.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam (Jurong)
sentences.text: I am, therefore, very supportive of Mentoring SG and its efforts in promoting a mentoring culture and making it accessible to youths through the community-driven digital platform Mentoring SG Connect.

sections.label: Donation collaboration for lower-income groups

sentences.text: The proposed collaboration with the Community Foundation of Singapore, MSF and Community Chest will provide opportunity for those who are in a position to donate materially to support those from lower-income groups.

sentences.text: The ESG Coordination Office, operated by the Singapore Business Federation (SBF), was set up for businesses to play a more significant role in society.

sections.label: Registered co-ops and their services
sections.summary: There are 80 registered co-ops providing services including supermarket, thrift and loan, childcare and welfare services.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mohd Fahmi Aliman
sentences.text: Today, there are 80 registered co-ops that provide a variety of services, including supermarket, thrift and loan, childcare and welfare services.

sections.label: Senior volunteer increases reported by CNA
sections.summary: CNA reported Lions Befriender Service Association's senior volunteers rose four times from 2021 to 2022, and RSVP saw a 30% increase.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Last year, CNA reported that Lions Befriender Service Association saw the number of their senior volunteers increased by four times from 2021 to 2022.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: RSVP was also reported to see a 30% increase.

sections.label: SG Care Volunteer Centres in all towns
sections.summary: SG Care Volunteer Centres are set up across all 24 towns to match community needs with volunteers and resources, with all 24 established two years ago.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng (Tampines)
sentences.text: SG Care Volunteer Centres (VCs) are now set up across all 24 towns in Singapore to support needs on the ground by matching the needs with volunteers and resources.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng (Tampines)
sentences.text: As these centres are operated by organisations based in the community, they know the needs in the respective communities better, are better connected to resources and can broker supply and demand at the town level more effectively.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng (Tampines)
sentences.text: This initiative started in 2018 in a few towns, and it has been two years since all 24 VCs were established.

sections.label: Singapore Government Partnerships Office launch
sections.summary: Deputy Prime Minister Lawrence Wong launched the Singapore Government Partnerships Office in January to strengthen partnerships and engagements with citizens.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng (Tampines)
sentences.text: Deputy Prime Minister Lawrence Wong launched the Singapore Government Partnerships Office (SGPO) in January to strengthen the Government's partnerships and engagements with citizens.

sections.label: Cross-agency proposals and no double-dipping
sections.summary: The portal can help proposals cutting across agencies that may become orphans, and there is also a no double-dipping policy.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng (Tampines)
sentences.text: One area that this portal can help is in areas where a proposal might cut across portfolios of different Government agencies but yet become an orphan in a way that it might not feature too highly in any one agencies' agenda.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng (Tampines)
sentences.text: Then there is also the policy of no double-dipping.

sections.label: Pew survey on post-pandemic unity
sections.summary: A Pew Research Centre post-pandemic survey found Singapore among a small minority of countries that grew more united after the pandemic.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: According to a post-pandemic survey by the Pew Research Centre, Singapore was amongst a small minority of countries that grew more united after the pandemic.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: According to a national survey by Sport Singapore (SportSG), sport participation among Singapore residents risen from 54% in 2015 to an all-time high of 74% in 2022.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: The sports participation rate for persons with disabilities also nearly doubled from 28% to 54%, in the same period.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: For example, the SportCares bursary covers seasonal participation fees for nine ActiveSG academies and clubs the entire season – covered by the bursary.

sections.label: Community championship sports

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: The community championship will focus on five popular sports to begin with – badminton, basketball, football, pickleball and table tennis.

sections.label: One Team Singapore Fund extension

sentences.text: So, we will do our best to broaden the options for Singaporeans to pursue a wider range of sports.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: This is why we extended the One Team Singapore Fund (OTSF) to 2027, as the Deputy Prime Minister announced and will be expanding the scope for donations eligible for one-to-one matching.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Over the years, SportSG has retrofitted swimming pools with ramps for wheelchairs at eight ActiveSG sport centres, with two more pools being retrofitted by 2025 and we have built eight inclusive ActiveSG gyms.

sections.label: 2023 SEA Games medal results
sections.summary: At the 2023 Southeast Asian Games, Team Singapore won 158 medals and ranked sixth overall.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: To give you some highlights: in the 2023 Southeast Asian Games (SEA Games), Team Singapore brought home 158 medals and ranked sixth overall.

sections.label: Sports Excellence programme stipends

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: For athletes competing at the world level like Maximilian and others like Kean Yew and Shanti, we give them the highest level of support.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: They are all on the highest tier of the Sports Excellence (spex) programme, which provides a monthly stipend to the athletes.

sections.label: spexBusiness athlete employment programme
sections.summary: Under the spexBusiness programme, athletes get flexible work arrangements with employers, and 400 athletes have been hired to date.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: We have a programme with these employers, so that our athletes can work with them but enjoy flexible work arrangements to accommodate training and competition.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: They also provide employment to ex-Team Singapore athletes and, to date, 400 athletes have been hired under the spexBusiness programme.

sections.label: spexPotential support for young athletes
sections.summary: From August 2024, spexPotential will provide financial and programmatic support to junior athletes earlier in their careers, bridging a gap.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: In addition, from August 2024, the spexPotential programme will support more young athletes trying to make the transition to the next level.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Our spexScholarship, the one I just mentioned, has been very successful.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: But the bar for acquiring that spexScholarship can be high – often benchmarked at Asian Games medal potential.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: This could mean that an athlete might sometimes be less supported earlier on in their journey.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: So, the spexPotential programme is a new one that bridges this gap, allows more athletes with potential to be supported at an earlier stage of their sporting career. spexPotential will provide both financial, as well as programmatic support – such as coaching, overseas training and competition, local training, sports science, sports medicine, as well as equipment – for our junior athletes.

sections.label: Major Sports Events Fund investment
sections.summary: The Government will invest S$165 million in the Major Sports Events Fund over the next four years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: The Government will invest S$165 million in the Major Sports Events Fund over the next four years to do this.

sections.label: New indoor arena development

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: So, we believe that it is now an opportune time to develop a new indoor arena that will be amongst the best-in-class globally.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)

sections.label: Arts and culture attendance growth

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: Deputy Prime Minister Lawrence Wong announced in the 2024 Budget that an additional $100 million would be allocated over the four years of Our SG Arts Plan 2023 to 2027.

sections.label: Arts for health and wellness framework
sections.summary: NAC will collaborate with AIC and SingHealth to develop by 2027 a framework and resources guiding arts programmes for health and wellness.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: For example, participants in the series of mindful "Slow Art" programmes by the National Gallery Singapore reported lower stress levels and enhanced well-being, compared to non-attendees.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: So, I am glad to announce that NAC will collaborate with the Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) and SingHealth to develop a framework and resources to guide the design of programmes that promote the arts for health and wellness.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: The framework, to be developed by 2027, will include best practices, impact measurement tools and case studies that can be used by artists and our community partners.

sections.label: Youth Heritage Blueprint development
sections.summary: NHB involved 35 young people on a panel developing the inaugural Youth Heritage Blueprint, to be published in July this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: To this end, the NHB has involved 35 young people on its panel to develop the inaugural Youth Heritage Blueprint.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: Since January 2023, the Youth Panel has received feedback and suggestions from more than 1,000 youths.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: The Panel is analysing the findings and developing recommendations for the Blueprint, which will be published in July this year.

sections.label: Heritage Activation Nodes in Katong and Clementi
sections.summary: The first Heritage Activation Node will be introduced in Katong-Joo Chiat in April 2024, and the second in Clementi later this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: The first of these nodes will be introduced in Katong – Joo Chiat just next month, April 2024; while the second HAN in Clementi will be rolled out in the later part of this year.

sections.label: $100 million for Our SG Arts Plan
sections.summary: Deputy Prime Minister Lawrence Wong announced in this year's Budget Statement $100 million for Our SG Arts Plan from 2023 to 2027, supporting three key thrusts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: Deputy Prime Minister Lawrence Wong announced in this year's Budget Statement that the Government will allocate $100 million for Our SG Arts Plan from 2023 to 2027.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: This funding will support three key thrusts: first, building a Connected Society; second, developing Singapore's Creative Economy; and third, establishing Singapore as a Distinctive City.

sections.label: Heritage nodes and arts for well-being
sections.summary: NHB will roll out two new Heritage Activation Nodes this year, and NAC will collaborate with healthcare partners to promote arts activities improving well-being.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: For example, NHB will roll out two new Heritage Activation Nodes consecutively this year – one in Katong-Joo Chiat and the other in Clementi.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: Arts and culture not only bring communities together, it can also cultivate our character, allowing us to experience the beauty of life and bringing us positive energy.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: Therefore, this year, NAC will collaborate with healthcare partners to promote arts and cultural activities with the aim of improving the well-being of Singaporeans.

sections.label: Arts and heritage plans
sections.summary: MCCY, NAC and NHB commit to working with private, public and people sectors to grow a distinctive city anchored on shared arts and culture.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: MCCY, NAC, NHB, we are committed to working closely with our partners in the private sector, public sector and people sectors to deepen our shared identity and grow a distinctive city that is anchored on our shared arts and culture, because our artists and our practitioners form the powerhouse for Singapore’s creative economy.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: With our arts and heritage plans in place, we have the chance to turn our aspirations into reality – to become a creative city that inspires.

sections.label: YAC funding for youths
sections.summary: Over five seasons of YAC, funding was awarded to more than 1,000 youths and over 280 youth projects.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: Over the past five seasons of YAC, we have awarded funding to more than 1,000 youths and over 280 youth projects that tackle issues like sustainability, social isolation and mental well-being.

sections.label: Youth views in policy panels
sections.summary: Panels receive agency support, and youths' views will be incorporated into recommendations tabled in Parliament, implemented or addressed via other channels.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: These panels also receive support from Government agencies throughout their term, including access to agencies' policy considerations, expertise and data, to inform their policy deliberations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: We will ensure that the views of our youths are incorporated into the policy panels' recommendations, and then either table these recommendations in Parliament for debate, implement them or address them via other channels, such as written responses.

sections.label: Volunteers serving VCs
sections.summary: Since 2018, close to 100,000 volunteers have served with 24 VCs, reaching over 600,000 beneficiaries.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: Since 2018, close to 100,000 volunteers have served with these 24 VCs, reaching over 600,000 beneficiaries.

sections.label: Volunteer lawyers at temple
sections.summary: Forty volunteer lawyers served over 800 clients at the Community Law Centre at Tian De Temple in 2023 alone.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: Forty volunteer lawyers have served over 800 clients at the Community Law Centre at Tian De Temple in 2023 alone.

sections.label: Town operator changes
sections.summary: Over the past five years, only three towns have changed operators, and in every case a smooth transition is ensured.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: Over the past five years, only three towns have changed operators and, in every case, we ensure a smooth transition.

sections.label: Equipping HC leaders
sections.summary: By 2025, 800 key HC leaders will be equipped with skills like mediation and crisis preparedness to bolster social harmony.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: By 2025, we will equip 800 key HC leaders with skills, such as mediation and crisis preparedness, to bolster social harmony in peacetime and in times of crises.

sections.label: Well-being circles network work
sections.summary: There are 12 well-being circles, over 600 individuals trained in peer support, and more than 3,000 people reached.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: Ms Hany Soh asked about the work done by the network thus far.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: We now have 12 well-being circles at various locales.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: They have trained over 600 individuals in peer support skills and reached more than 3,000 people through their programmes.

sections.label: Mentoring SG WSQ course
sections.summary: Mentoring SG rolled out a WSQ accredited course, Mentoring for Youth, equipping mentors with facilitation and communication skills.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: Last month, Mentoring SG rolled out a Singapore Workforce Skills Qualifications (WSQ) accredited course called Mentoring for Youth, which equips mentors with effective facilitation and communication skills through scenario-based practices.

sections.label: The Collective launch
sections.summary: The Collective, by CFS with MSF, Community Chest and MCCY, connects donors with causes and non-profits to address unmet needs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: Today, I am glad to announce the launch of this initiative, called The Collective for a Stronger Society, or The Collective, for short.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: Put together by the Community Foundation of Singapore (CFS), in partnership with MSF and the Community Chest, and supported by MCCY, The Collective will connect donors with causes, where donors can navigate causes on the ground that uplift lower-income families; direct their resources to non-profits, social enterprises and other partners that lead impactful initiatives; and identify gaps in the landscape; and come up with fresh solutions that address unmet needs in society.

sections.label: Singapore Government Partnerships Office
sections.summary: SGPO was launched in January to partner citizens and stakeholders keen to work with the Government on their ideas.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: The other platform is our Singapore Government Partnerships Office (SGPO), which we launched in January, to partner citizens and stakeholders who are keen to work with the Government to turn their ideas into reality.

sections.label: Sport facilities within 10-minute walk
sections.summary: The ambition is a 10-minute walk to affordable sport facilities by around 2030; 10 SIP facilities built, 24 more in development.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: Our ambition is for Singaporeans to be able to take a 10-minute walk from home to affordable sport facilities by around 2030.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: Today, SportSG has built 10 Sport-in-Precinct (SIP) facilities with another 24 more projects in various development stages.

sections.label: New Punggol Regional Sport Centre
sections.summary: The new Punggol Regional Sport Centre features a 5,000-seater stadium, swimming complex, indoor sports hall, sheltered tennis and futsal courts, water sports centre and archery field.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: A 5,000-seater stadium, swimming complex, 20-badminton-court-sized indoor sports hall, sheltered tennis and futsal courts, water sports centre and an archery field are features of the new Punggol Regional Sport Centre.

sections.label: Government matching SportCares donations
sections.summary: Deputy Prime Minister Lawrence Wong announced the Government will match dollar-for-dollar all donations to SportCares from April this year onwards.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: In his Budget speech last month, Deputy Prime Minister Lawrence Wong announced that the Government will match dollar-for-dollar, all donations to SportCares from April this year onwards.

sections.label: FAS National Head coach attributes
sections.summary: FAS considers key attributes when selecting a National Head coach, including developing players, supervising the Under-22 team, and uplifting the football ecosystem.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: When selecting a National Head coach, FAS considers the following key attributes; one, the candidate needs to demonstrate a track record of developing players and have a robust strategy in preparing and fielding a team to achieve results; two, apart from the National “A” team, the candidate would also supervise the Under-22 team together with the Under-22 Head Coach; three, the candidate is expected to uplift the football ecosystem, impart knowledge and raise the overall profile of football.

sections.label: School Football Academies growth
sections.summary: There are now 15 School Football Academies, five with girls' programmes, and young footballers have doubled from 300 in 2022 to over 830 this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: A critical part of this is developing a structured football development system so that we can raise the standards of Singapore football at all levels.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: We now have 15 School Football Academies (SFAs), of which five have dedicated programmes for girls.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: We have also doubled the number of young footballers from 300 youths in 10 pilot SFAs in 2022 when we started, to over 830 male and female young footballers this year.

sections.label: Overseas study and training scholarships
sections.summary: Scholarships allow study and training overseas at world-renowned academies, the IMG Academy in Florida and ESC LaLiga in Madrid.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: Scholarships to study and train overseas at world-renowned academies – the IMG Academy in Florida, USA and the ESC LaLiga in Madrid, Spain.

sections.label: OTS expanded to Athletes Inspire Fund
sections.summary: The OTSF will be expanded to support the Athletes Inspire Fund, which funds athletes in emerging sports, with three application windows yearly.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: We recognise that our athletes in emerging sports, such as powerlifting and pickleball, have performed well internationally.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: Therefore, I am pleased to announce that the OTSF will be expanded to support the Athletes Inspire Fund (AIF).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: The AIF provides funding support for athletes who represent Singapore in emerging sports.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: The funding support may cover cost items, such as airfare, accommodation, registration fees, visa fees, travel insurance and equipment.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: And there will be three application windows each year: in March, July and November.

sections.label: SportCares bursaries for children
sections.summary: SportCares bursaries give children and youths from low-income families access to sports, enabling over 480 to learn new activities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: Through the SportCares bursaries, children and youths from low-income families have increased access to quality sports, such as basketball, football, track and field, field hockey, water polo, canoeing, table tennis and so on.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: So far, the SportCares bursaries have enabled over 480 children and youths to learn new sport activities.

sections.label: Arts and health framework
sections.summary: NAC's collaboration with AIC and SingHealth will develop an evidence-based framework using arts to promote seniors' health and well-being.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: In preparing for this collaboration with SingHealth and AIC, we checked and overseas studies on the impact of arts on well-being have clearly shown that adults who participate in arts and cultural activities are: one, more likely to have better cognitive reserve in later life; two, less likely to develop dementia; three, have lower levels of frailty and chronic pain in older adulthood; four, less likely to experience loneliness and depression; and five, likely to live longer.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Turning to her clarification, NAC's collaboration with healthcare partners – AIC, starting with SingHealth – to develop a framework for the arts to promote health and well-being, will bring the power of the arts into the lives of our seniors for a start.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Initially focusing on seniors, the new framework to promote well-being through the arts will be built on an evidence-based approach, interdisciplinary expertise from both the arts and the healthcare sector and also based on existing research.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: And the guide will include strategy on how arts programme can be designed to achieve well-being outcomes, best practices, case studies and also impact measuring tools that are in line with and very, very importantly, validated by our healthcare sector.

sections.label: Gillman Barracks studies and leases

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: MND will be starting heritage and environmental studies in the second quarter this year.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: But I want to assure her and also the tenants at Gillman Barracks that the tenants at Gillman Barracks can continue to stay on till the end of their leases.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: HDB, URA and the Singapore Land Authority (SLA) have shared that any further extension or retention of the current uses in Gillman Barracks will be assessed at a later point when their studies are over and when the development plans are ready.

sections.label: Arts gross floor area increase

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: From 2010 to 2023, the Arts gross floor area (GFA) increased by 42%, from 66,000 square metres to 94,000 square metres.

sections.label: School football academies growth
sections.summary: School football academies grew from 10 in 2022 to 15 in 2024, including five dedicated to girls.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: The school football academies, for instance, we started with 10 in 2022.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: And now, in 2024, we have 15 academies that have been set up and includes five that are dedicated to girls as well.

sections.label: Local players and e-Sport Week
sections.summary: Local players will be involved in training, and last year Singapore hosted the inaugural Olympics e-Sport Week.

sentences.text: To the Member's specific point about involving local players for training and so on, the answer is clearly yes, we will do so.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Last year, we hosted the inaugural Olympics e-Sport Week, the first time the event was here, supported many by local contractors.

sections.label: Table tennis event in Singapore
sections.summary: A table tennis grand slam is hosted in Singapore with support from secondees, trainees and corporate partners, involving knowledge transfer.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: In fact, this week, for those Members who are done with Committee of Supply and have nothing else to do, please go and support the Singapore team, Izaac Quek and others will be playing.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Also a major event, a grand slam of the table tennis world, hosted in Singapore, but also supported by many other secondees and trainees from Singapore Table Tennis Association, from SportSG, who help to run the event in partnership with the International Table Tennis Federation, so, knowledge transfer, know-how, how we manage an event like this, how we manage the overall flow of the event, plus also some of the Singapore corporates being direct partners.

sections.label: Coach registry support schemes
sections.summary: NAC will look into the Member's proposed sustainable practices with NICA, and registered coaches or exercise professionals are eligible for support.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: The Member's proposed sustainable practices is something that NAC will certainly follow up and look into and work in consultation with NICA.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: I give her assurance that so long as a coach is registered with either the National Registry of Coaches or the National Registry of Exercise Professionals, he or she is eligible for support under these two schemes.

sections.label: The Collective community platform
sections.summary: MCCY will continue supporting The Collective, which brings stakeholders together to contribute funds and mentoring for lower-income families and raise awareness.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The Collective is another platform for the community to come together and MCCY will continue to support that, to bring different stakeholders to contribute their financial as well as mentoring resources, to better support lower-income families.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: But it is also more than just about raising donations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: It is about raising awareness of the needs of the community.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: If you are part of a corporate or individual and you want to know where to deploy your capital, your time, your expertise, The Collective will be able to do that for you.
